#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting:
next Monday at 10:00 AM local time, lasting 2 hours (10:00-12:00)."""

import datetime
import uuid

# --- Determine "next Monday" ---
now = datetime.datetime.now()
today = now.date()
# days until the next Monday; if today is Monday, use the Monday 7 days out
days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_monday = today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Compute start/end in local time, then convert to UTC for unambiguous ICS ---
local_tz = now.astimezone().tzinfo
start_local = datetime.datetime.combine(
    next_monday, datetime.time(10, 0), tzinfo=local_tz
)
end_local = start_local + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)
start_utc = start_local.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
end_utc = end_local.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
stamp_utc = now.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)

def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"
summary = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
description = "Project kickoff meeting to align on goals, scope, roles, and timeline."

# --- Build ICS content (RFC 5545) ---
lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Project Kickoff//Calendar Skill//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(stamp_utc)}",
    f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_utc)}",
    f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_utc)}",
    f"SUMMARY:{summary}",
    f"DESCRIPTION:{description}",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    f"DESCRIPTION:Reminder: {summary} starts soon",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"
out_path = "project_kickoff.ics"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(content)

print(f"Output file: {out_path}")
print(f"Today: {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Monday: {next_monday} ({next_monday.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start (local, {local_tz}): {start_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
print(f"End   (local, {local_tz}): {end_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
print(f"Start (UTC): {start_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}")
print(f"End   (UTC): {end_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}")
print(f"Duration: {(end_local - start_local).seconds // 3600} hour(s)")
print(f"UID: {uid}")
